title: promptctl's directory/glob change index misses a PR merge commit that differs from both parents, so prompts-ci goes red on PRs behind main
problem: test_promptctl.LastChangeIndexTest.test_lookups_without_a_git_call_match_the_per_file_call failed on PR #19647's `validate` job (job 140360572932, 2026-11-27 07:01 UTC) for path='prompts/' and 'prompts/runs/*.json': index ' (file last changed on or before 2026-11-26, the shallow-clone edge)' vs git ' (file last changed 2026-11-27)', 2026-11-27T06:59:17Z. CI checks out refs/pull/N/merge at depth 2. The PR added a run record and main had added others since the PR's base, so the merge commit's prompts/ differs from both parents and `git log -1 -- prompts/` names the merge. `--diff-merges=c` lists only files that differ from every parent; each record matches one parent, so the merge lists none of them and _dir_hit/_glob_hit fall through to a shallow root. Any PR that adds a run record while main also gains one hits it, which is most PRs during busy hours.
evidence: PR #19647 validate job 140360572932 log: 2 subtest failures, paths prompts/ and prompts/runs/*.json
prompts/promptctl.py _last_change_indexes: `--diff-merges=c`; _dir_hit/_glob_hit read only the per-file indexes
change: For directory and glob lookups, when HEAD is a merge whose tree differs from every parent under the prefix (one `git diff --quiet HEAD^1 HEAD -- <prefix>` and the same for ^2), answer HEAD; or have _index_hit return None for dirs/globs in a merge checkout so the per-file call answers. Add a test with a two-root merge where each parent adds a different file under the same directory.
metric: validate failures of this test on PRs in the 14 days after a fix
baseline: 1 seen (PR #19647, 2026-11-27); worked around by merging main into the branch
